claim_type: short walkthrough repo + upstream issue for runx

audience: runx maintainers and developers evaluating runx as an agent skill runtime
venue: public GitHub repo under my account + upstream runx issue tracker
why_allowed: Original content useful to maintainer and future contributors; project sharing is normal on GitHub; no spam, no duplicates, no fake accounts.
